One Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken Bake🔥410 cals 37g protein 11g fat 40g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 meals 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 ½ cups jasmine rice, uncooked 3 cups chicken broth, warmed 1 medium yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 1 ½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved 2 cups baby spinach, roughly chopped 4 cloves garlic, minced 50g freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 tsp Italian seasoning 1 ½ tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ¾ tsp smoked paprika ¾ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ tsp red pepper flakes (optional) ¼ cup fresh parsley, finely chopped Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F 2. Add chicken thigh, 1 ½ cups uncooked rice, diced onion, red bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, spinach, and minced garlic directly to the baking dish. 3. Season with 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 ½ tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, ¾ tsp smoked paprika, ¾ tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper, and red pepper flakes if using. 4. Pour in 3 cups chicken broth and stir everything together until evenly combined and the rice is submerged. 5. Cover the baking dish tightly with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes. 6. Remove the foil and add fresh parm and go back in the oven uncovered for another 15 mins at 400° 7. Finish with the remaining fresh parsley  Serve hot and enjoy! Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

I realized I never gave ya’ll the recipe to my BigBrownieChunks or bbc recipe so…here ya go! So gooey!  🍫Pan: 8×8-inch light metal pan Oven: 350°F Ingredients: * 1 cup (226 g) unsalted butter * 1⅓ cups (120 g) Dutch-processed cocoa powder * 1 teaspoon fine sea salt * 2½ cups powdered sugar * ½ cup light brown sugar * 3 large eggs, room temperature * 1 additional egg yolk, room temperature * 3 teaspoons vanilla extract * 1 cup (120 g) all-purpose flour * 1½ cups (280 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips * ½ cup chopped semi-sweet chocolate bar * Powdered sugar, for finishing Step-by-Step 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Line an 8×8-inch light metal pan with parchment paper. 2. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Continue cooking, stirring frequently, until it becomes golden brown, smells nutty, and you can see browned milk solids at the bottom. 3. Add the cocoa powder and salt to a heat safe bowl. Immediately pour the hot browned butter over the cocoa and whisk or stir until completely smooth and glossy. Let cool until warm, not hot. 4. Whisk the sugars & eggs for that crackle top! In a separate large bowl, combine the powdered sugar, brown sugar, 3 eggs, and additional egg yolk. Whisk HARD for 60–90 seconds, until the mixture looks lighter, thick, glossy, and well combined. 5. Stir the vanilla into the warm cocoa butter mixture. Pour the cocoa mixture into the egg & sugar mixture and whisk until the batter is thick, dark, smooth, and shiny. 6. Gently fold in the flour just until the last dry streak disappears. Do not overmix. 7. Reserve 1/4 cup of batter for extra crackle top! set it aside. 8. Gently fold 1½ cups semi-sweet chocolate chips into the remaining batter. Spread the chocolate-chip brownie batter evenly into the prepared pan. 9. Make the smooth crackle layer Take the reserved ¼ cup of chip-free batter and spread it very thinly over the surface. 10. Sprinkle the ½ cup chopped semi-sweet chocolate bar over the top. These will melt into gooey chocolate pockets. 11. Bake at 350°F for 28–35 minutes. Don’t wait for a completely clean toothpick! the brownies are supposed to stay molten and fudgy inside. 12. Let the brownies cool completely in the pan before lifting them out. #brownies #brownierecipe #molten #chocolate

Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

Don’t know what to make for dinner? Make this! This Italian baked chicken with potatoes, red onion, olives, rosemary and white wine all cooks together in one pan. It’s an easy family dinner with simple ingredients and tons of flavor. The best part is dinners like this practically cook themselves, which makes them perfect for weeknights. ⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 serving (1 meal prep): Protein: 47g Carbs: 78g Fat: 13g Calories: 616 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 14oz chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 3 tbsp cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil Honey Soy Glaze - 2 tbsp soy sauce - 3/4 tbsp oyster sauce - 2 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic - 1/2 tbsp minced ginger Korean Cucumber Kimchi Salad - 3 Persian cucumbers, whole, medium - 1/4 tbsp salt - 1/2 tbsp rice vinegar - 1/2 tbsp minced garlic - 1/2 tbsp sesame oil - 1 tbsp gochugaru - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1/2 tbsp brown sugar - 1 tsp sesame seeds Rice (and topping) - 1.25 cup cooked rice (white or brown) - 2 green onions, medium - 1 tsp sesame seeds How to make it yourself: 1. Cut your cucumbers into 1 inch pieces and crush them with a mallet 2. In a bowl, add your cucumbers and salt and set aside for 10 minutes. 3. Drain all excess liquid, rise your cucumbers with water, pat them dry with a paper towel, and in a new bowl add rice vinegar, minced, garlic, sesame oil, sesame seeds, soy sauce, brown sugar, and gochugaru and mix well to make your spicy cucumber kimchi 4. Season your chicken evenly with salt, pepper, and cornstarch 5. In a bowl, mix together soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, minced garlic, and minced ginger to make your glaze 6. In a pan on medium hear coated with spray oil, cook your chicken until golden brown, then flip and cook until both sides are golden brown with a crispy crust 7. Lower the heat to low and pour your glaze on top of the chicken and let it sit for 1 minute 8. In a meal prep container, add half your cooked rice, half your chicken, half your cucumber kimchi salad, and top it off with sesame seeds and diced green onions and enjoy! 📩 Save this Crispy Asian Soy Glazed Chicken Meal Prep recipe to make for later and if you make it, post it and tag me in it! La crecida repentina del río Budhi Gandaki arrasa unas 40 viviendas y varios puentes y deja al menos cinco desaparecidos.El agua también daña instalaciones eléctricas, torres de comunicaciones y las obras de una central hidroeléctrica. El Ejército moviliza helicópteros y equipos terrestres y comunica el rescate de 49 personas. Las autoridades envían unos 200.000 mensajes de alerta para pedir evacuaciones ante el riesgo de nuevas crecidas. Las primeras investigaciones apuntan a un desprendimiento que bloqueó temporalmente un afluente: al romperse la barrera natural, una enorme masa de agua y lodo se precipitó río abajo. Los registros meteorológicos no muestran lluvias en las cabeceras que expliquen la inundación. La emergencia llega cuando Nepal todavía se recupera de las devastadoras inundaciones de agosto, que dejaron más de 1.400 muertos y miles de desaparecidos cerca de la frontera con China. El Gobierno había anunciado esta semana el fin de la búsqueda activa de víctimas de aquella catástrofe para concentrar los recursos en la reconstrucción de las zonas afectadas. 📲 ¡Síguenos para estar al tanto de la actualidad! #inundacion #ultimahora #breaking #nepal #viral

Ingredients: 1 (25-ounce) package frozen cheese ravioli 3 1/2 cups store-bought Alfredo sauce 1 pound Italian sausage, cooked and crumbled 3 cups baby spinach 1/2 cup chopped marinated sundried tomatoes 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese, divided 1/2 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese, divided Directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (180 degrees C). Lightly grease a 3 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Spread about 1/2 cup sauce on the bottom of the dish and arrange half of the ravioli in a single layer over the sauce. Top with cooked sausage, spinach, and sundried tomatoes. Pour 1 1/2 cups of alfredo sauce over the spinach mixture. Sprinkle with half of the mozzarella and Parmesan cheese and top with the remaining ravioli in a single layer. Pour over remaining sauce and top with remaining mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses. Cover and bake for about 1 hour, uncovering during the last 15 minutes, until golden brown around the edges and bubbly. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. 🧑‍🍳: Nicole #ravioli #bakedravioli #easydinners #dinner #dinnerideas

Replying to @naomi when pricing my pieces I consider time spent making/decorating/signing/waxing/glazing/sanding/lustering/firing/invetorying. I have done time studies to help gauge the time I spend on making the pieces. I also consider materials used. I apply gold luster to almost every piece and it’s expensive and requires an additional firing which is also another expense. I also consider experience. I have been working with clay for 14 years now so I consider all of those years of working to this point in my pieces value as well. Pricing is hard! Placing a value on your art is uncomfortable. I’m just happy to be here and I’m doing my best with the knowledge I have gained so far on this journey. I don’t think there is a right answer that will work for everyone, I’m just trying to do what feels right to me! ✨ Want a stunning, weed-free flower bed? Try this easy "pot-in-pot" landscaping hack to keep your borders looking fresh all year long! 📦 First, lay down cardboard along your path and space out heavy-duty black base pots on top. The cardboard acts as an amazing, natural weed barrier. 💧 Next, pour gravel all around the base pots. This hides the cardboard, holds your base pots securely in place, and provides excellent water drainage. 🪴 Now just drop your decorative plants-still in their own nursery pots-directly into the base pots! You can swap them out in seconds when seasons change or easily lift them inside if a freeze hits. 💡 Pro-tips: Mix up your flower colors, put the taller plants in the back, and always match your plants to the amount of sunlight that wall gets.

Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers!!!  Tender chicken coated in a honey garlic soy sauce with sautéed peppers. Sticky, savory, and perfect over rice!!!  Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers  2 large chicken breast  Neutral oil  1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp soy 1/2 tsp onion powder  1 tsp cornstarch  Sauce  Bell peppers, sliced (for sautéing) 1 tsp ginger paste or grated  2 tbsp garlic paste  2 tbsp honey  1/4 cup light and dark soy combined  1 tsp rice seasoning  1 tbsp hoisin sauce  1/2 tbsp oyster sauce  1/2 tsp Totole Granulated Chicken Flavor Season the chicken with neutral oil, seasonings, and cornstarch. Marinate for at least 2 hours. Cook the chicken in a skillet 2–3 minutes per side until lightly browned, then remove and set aside. In the same pan, sauté the sliced peppers until they reach your desired texture, then add the garlic paste. Pour in the sauce and simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally. If needed, add a 1:1 cornstarch slurry to thicken. Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together until coated. Garnish with sliced green onions and enjoy #Foodie #cooking #food #honeygarlicchicken #chicken

SAVE THIS for the next time you don’t know what to make for dinner 🍗😂 This easy oven baked chicken recipe is one of my favorite lazy meals because it’s juicy, flavorful, easy to meal prep and requires very little actual work. For 12 chicken drumsticks: • 1 packet Sazón • 2 tsp Italian seasoning • 2 tsp garlic powder • 2 tsp onion powder • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp Tony Chachere’s Creole Seasoning • 1 cup olive oil & yes, I went HEAVY 😂 • Juice of 1 whole lemon added RIGHT BEFORE THE OVEN 🍋 Season everything really well, cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 12–24 hours. The longer, the better! When you’re ready to cook, place the chicken in an oven safe dish and squeeze the juice of one whole lemon directly over the chicken. Bake UNCOVERED at 400°F for about 90 minutes, making sure your chicken reaches at least 165°F internally. I typically turn the drumsticks halfway through so both sides get some love, but you can skip that step if you want! Pair it with mashed potatoes + a veggie and dinner is DONE. 🙌🏾 Perfect for an easy weeknight dinner, meal prep or high protein meal when you don’t feel like doing the most. Five plants that separate a designed garden from a planted one. Rosemary — most people treat it as a herb. Designers use it as a structural evergreen with silver foliage, late winter bloom, and serious drought tolerance once established. Echinops — steel-blue globe thistle that holds its form into winter. Pollinators love it, it seeds around just enough, and nothing else gives you that texture. White Cloud Nepeta — all the soft billowing habit of catmint, none of the blue. Cleaner in a white or silver palette. Underused because most people don’t know it exists. Mountain Hydrangea (Hydrangea serrata) — more refined than arborescens, lacecap form, better fall color, and it actually performs in part shade without flopping. Blue Mist Fothergilla (Fothergilla gardenii ‘Blue Mist’) — blue-green foliage all season, then flame in fall. Native, compact, and genuinely beautiful. The plant that makes clients ask “what is that?” #gardendesign #landscapedesign

Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Creamy Chicken Au Poivre 🍗✨ This might be one of the best ways I’ve ever prepared a whole chicken.  Listen it’s juicy, crispy skin and that creamy peppercorn sauce is EVERYTHINGGG 😮‍💨 thank you @Corre Larkin for sharing this recipe with us! 💕 My version of the viral chicken au poivre: For the chicken: • 1 whole young chicken (4–5 lb), spatchcocked, cleaned and pat dry  • drizzle of good quality olive oil • Salt, to taste For the creamy au poivre sauce:  • 1½ cups heavy cream (I used lactose free) • 2 sprigs fresh rosemary, chopped • 3 cloves garlic, chopped • 1 shallot, sliced • 2 tbsp crushed black peppercorns (more or less, and you can ground the texture as coarse or as fine as you like. This is entirely based on preference since they add a kick) • Generous pinch of salt • ½ Kickin’ Chicken Seasoning Bomb  (optional, yes you can sub with a bouillon cube or seasoning) • Splash of sherry cooking wine How to make it: Pat the chicken dry, massage with olive oil and season with salt on both sides. Roast at 375°F for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, steep the heavy cream with the rosemary, garlic, shallot, cracked peppercorns, salt and ½ Kickin’ Chicken Seasoning Bomb. You want to make sure this is simmering, not boiling, so steam coming from the pot and some *small* bubbles are okay! 👌  Once the 15 minute timer is up, remove the chicken from the oven and pour the creamy au poivre sauce all over. Add a splash of sherry cooking wine and pop it back in the oven to finish roasting at 400 F. Let it roast until the chicken is golden brown and fully cooked through to 165°F.  Save this for your next chicken dinner! 📌🍗 #chickenaupoivre #tiktokrecipecontest #stepbystep #viralrecipe #creamychicken

Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. (Polícia de South Yorkshire) Após o ocorrido, o parque foi evacuado e permaneceu fechado neste domingo (11). Funcionários que ficaram abalados com a situação também receberão acompanhamento especializado. (The Independent) A polícia informou que o tigre permaneceu dentro do recinto e não representava risco para o restante do público. As circunstâncias que levaram o homem a entrar na área do animal seguem sob investigação. As autoridades também pediram que as pessoas evitem compartilhar vídeos do ataque, em respeito à vítima e à família. videos.caption: Crispy chickpeas might be my new favorite pasta salad add-in 👏🏼 This Greek-inspired orzo pasta is crunchy, fresh, and so good for an easy no-microwave lunch. CRISPY CHICKPEA GREEK PASTA 🥗 • 1.5 cup orzo, cooked + cooled • 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved • 1 cup cucumber, chopped • ¼ cup red onion, thinly sliced • ½ cup crumbled feta • 1 can chickpeas, drained + dried well CRISPY CHICKPEAS • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp oregano • Salt + pepper Toss chickpeas with olive oil and seasonings. Air fry at 400°F until golden and crispy, about 12–15 minutes, shaking a couple times. GREEK DRESSING • ¼ cup olive oil • 2 tbsp red wine vinegar • 1 tbsp lemon juice • 1 tsp Dijon mustard • ½ tsp oregano • ½ tsp garlic powder • Salt + pepper Whisk the dressing together. Toss the orzo, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and feta with the dressing. Top with the crispy chickpeas right before eating so they stay crunchy. #pastasalad #lunchideas #mealprepideas #nomicrowavelunch #EasyRecipes

THE NEXT MAN 01 JUIN 5001 👁️‍🗨️⚡️🛸🚀⏳🌌🤠👑⚔️🔮🧬♾️Je regardais la mode et j’ai compris qu’elle tournait en rond. Les mêmes costumes. Les mêmes silhouettes. Les mêmes références. Les mêmes histoires racontées encore et encore. Alors j’ai décidé de ne plus regarder derrière moi. J’ai commencé à dessiner devant moi. Très loin devant moi. Là où personne n’est encore allé. 🚀 Ce que vous voyez n’est pas un costume. Ce n’est pas un uniforme. Ce n’est pas une armure. C’est une nouvelle espèce de silhouette. Une silhouette construite pour un homme qui refuse les catégories. ⚡️ Le chapeau porte la mémoire des conquérants 🤠👑. Les épaules portent le poids d’une vision. Les lignes métalliques traversent le vêtement comme des chemins vers un autre siècle 🛸. Les panneaux flottants créent un mouvement permanent. Les bottes transforment la marche en déclaration ⚔️. Chaque élément existe pour une seule raison : créer une présence impossible à ignorer. Certains verront un roi 👑. D’autres verront un guerrier ⚔️. D’autres verront un voyageur temporel ⏳. D’autres verront le premier homme d’un nouveau monde 🌌. Ils auront tous raison. Parce que cette silhouette n’appartient à aucune époque. Elle traverse toutes les époques. Elle ne regarde pas le passé. Elle ne suit pas le présent. Elle annonce simplement ce qui arrive après. Ce n’est pas une tendance. Ce n’est pas une mode. C’est un prototype humain. Le premier. 🧬♾️ La plupart des gens cherchent à ressembler à quelqu’un. Moi, j’ai choisi de ressembler à personne. Ne copiez pas. Créez. Le monde se souvient rarement des copies. Cozy & Affordable Baked Chicken Dinner 🍗🤎 Tonight I was going for cozy, comforting, and affordable, and this is one of my go-to dinners when I want something simple but still really good. Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3. Slice the peppers and onion. 4. Sauté the peppers and onions in a skillet until they begin to soften. 5. Add the cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Stir until smooth and creamy. 6. Place the seasoned chicken in a baking dish and pour the creamy mixture over the top. 7. Bake at 375°F for about 50–60 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and is fully cooked. 8. Serve with jasmine rice, French-style green beans, and a warm buttermilk biscuit finished with a little honey. Affordable, filling, and the perfect comfort dinner.
